answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Anchor. Each identity commits a hash of its first-epoch action sequence; later epochs must stay within a bounded delta of that baseline, or the identity is flagged and its reputation zeroed. Isolated accounts that never interact with the main behavioural cluster form a separate island with capped influence, so freshly minted sybils cannot gain weight by staying silent. A raven flag marks identities whose epoch-to-epoch divergence exceeds tolerance, freezing them until they rebuild history.
